capabilities: Compare a Markdown note with the Git HEAD baseline
Highlight added, modified, and deleted text with editor flags in Source mode and Live Preview
Navigate between individual changes with paired panel and source navigation
Restore individual changes after preview confirmation, as an undoable edit
extras: Desktop-only (requires Obsidian 1.8.0+); the README warns users to back up important notes first and states the plugin never stages, commits, or pushes. Only supports comparison against local Git HEAD; accepted-baseline review and GitLab comparison are planned but not yet available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see what changed in a note relative to the last Git commit or to selectively undo those changes while editing.
summary: Git diff viewer that compares edited Markdown notes against the Git HEAD, highlights changes in the editor, and restores individual changes after confirmation.
